content.title: Danone to Explore Buying Lifeway Foods. The Third Time Could Be Different.
content.summary: The French dairy company  Danone  will explore an acquisition of kefir maker  Lifeway Foods  for the third time in less than a year, according to a Securities and Exchange Commission filing.  The two companies entered into a confidentiality agreement Friday “to facilitate  Danone’s  further review of a potential acquisition transaction.”  Last year, Lifeway rejected two all-cash offers from Danone to acquire the company, for $25 and $27 a share, respectively.
